name: Laughing Goat
core: A mountain goat cackling with its mouth wide open, used for laughing hard at something absurd or someone's misfortune.
avoid: Not for sad or serious news.

name: Reaction Guys
core: A group of guys staring blankly at one thing and then going wild for another, used to show what bores people versus what excites them.
avoid: Not for things that get equal reactions.

name: I'm Never Going To Financially Recover From This
core: Joe Exotic lamenting 'I'm never gonna financially recover from this', used when something small or self-inflicted costs you way too much.
avoid: Not for genuine financial hardship.

name: Poke With Stick
core: A stick figure cautiously poking something with a stick, used for warily testing or provoking something you don't trust.
avoid: Not for confident direct action.

name: Samuel Jackson Glance
core: Samuel L. Jackson giving a sideways look of disbelief, used when someone says something suspicious or outrageous.
avoid: Not for calm agreement.

name: Titanic Band
core: The Titanic sinking while the band keeps calmly playing, used when people carry on as normal while everything collapses around them.
avoid: Not for situations that are actually fine.

name: Tighten There Is No Easter Bunny
core: Tighten from Megamind gleefully crushing illusions, 'there is no Easter Bunny, no Tooth Fairy, and there is no...', used to deliver a harsh truth that something hoped-for doesn't exist.
avoid: Not for confirming good news.

name: A Wizard Is Never Late
core: Gandalf insisting a wizard arrives precisely when he means to, used to excuse being late or arriving at the last possible moment.
avoid: Not for being genuinely punctual.

name: Thank You For Changing My Life
core: A bearded Nordic gamer wojak solemnly saying 'Thank you for changing my life', used to express deep gratitude to something that improved your life.
aliases: Thank You For Changing My Life
avoid: Not for things you dislike.

name: Beard Baby
core: A baby with a full grown-man beard, used for someone young or new acting way more mature or experienced than they are.
avoid: Not for actual veterans.

name: He Will Never
core: Cereal Guy reads a sad statement then spits out his cereal at a twist ending, used for a sympathetic setup with a shocking or absurd punchline.
aliases: He Will Never Have A Girlfriend
avoid: Not for stories without a twist.

name: Never Give Up
core: One miner keeps digging while another quits just inches from the diamonds; used for giving up right before success.
slots: one who quits just before success
avoid: Not for situations with no effort or payoff involved.

name: No Nappa It's A Trick
core: Vegeta frantically warns Nappa, who is about to fall for something obvious; used for warning someone off a tempting trap.
slots: the one about to fall for it
avoid: Not for calm advice or situations without a trap.

name: Tom And Spike Fighting
core: Spike and Tom duel while Jerry grins at the chaos; used when two parties fight and a third enjoys watching or benefits.
avoid: Not for situations where nobody enjoys the conflict.

name: PTSD Clarinet Boy
core: A grim boy flashes back to his happier clarinet days; used for being haunted by a memory triggered by something small.
avoid: Not for happy nostalgia without any dread.

name: Angry Pingu
core: Pingu sits with arms crossed, sulking; used to show grumpy, stubborn annoyance at something.
avoid: Not for real anger or happy moods.

name: Kurt Angle Stare
core: Kurt Angle stares wide-eyed into the camera; used for stunned, awkward disbelief at what someone just said or did.
avoid: Not for happy surprise or excitement.

name: Interstellar Smoking
core: A haggard man drags on a cigarette with a wide, haunted stare; used for weary shock after hearing something unsettling.
avoid: Not for cheerful or relaxed moods.

name: Two Cats Fighting
core: Two cats brawl mid-air; used to label two sides locked in a pointless, heated fight.
avoid: Not for friendly disagreements or one-sided situations.

name: Pony Shrugs
core: Rainbow Dash shrugs with a blank face; used for 'I don't know' or 'whatever, not my problem'.
avoid: Not for strong emotions or clear answers.

name: Lazy College Senior
core: A scruffy student drinking beer; used for confessions of lazy, half-hearted, senior-year-style effort.
avoid: Not for genuine hard work or achievement.

name: Grumpy Cat Happy
core: Grumpy Cat edited to look happy; used for rare joy, usually at someone else's misfortune or something sarcastic.
avoid: Not for plain grumpy reactions; use regular Grumpy Cat.

name: Andy Dropping Woody
core: Andy carelessly drops Woody, his old favourite; used for abandoning something you used to love for something new.
avoid: Not for things being treasured or kept.

name: Begun The Clone War Has
core: A grave Yoda announces that a war has begun; used when a petty conflict or rivalry officially kicks off.
avoid: Not for peaceful or resolved situations.

name: That Is One Big Pile Of Poop
core: Ian Malcolm stands beside a giant pile of dinosaur dung; used for facing an enormous mess.
avoid: Not for small or tidy problems.

name: Small Knight Giant Knight
core: A tiny knight faces a towering giant; used for a small person up against an overwhelming challenge.
avoid: Not for evenly matched fights.

name: Abbacchio Joins The Kicking
core: Two guys kick someone while Abbacchio calmly sips wine, then he leaps in to join; used when you can't resist piling on.
avoid: Not for real bullying or violence against people.

name: Remember That Time
core: Chris Farley excitedly asks a guest 'remember when...' then calls it awesome; used for gushing over a shared memory.
avoid: Not for bad memories or serious nostalgia.

name: Ghost Boo
core: A ghost says boo three times with no reaction, then says nothing and gets a scream; used when the quiet thing is scarier than the loud ones.
avoid: Not for things that are scary in the obvious way.

name: Emergency Alert
core: A blank phone emergency alert; used to announce a trivial or absurd 'emergency' with mock urgency.
avoid: Not for real emergencies or disasters.

name: Are You Not Entertained
core: Maximus shouts at the arena crowd 'Are you not entertained?'; used after delivering something impressive to an unimpressed audience.
avoid: Not for quiet or modest achievements.

name: Sad Baby
core: A baby on the verge of tears; used for small, petty disappointments that feel devastating.
avoid: Not for real grief or serious loss.

name: Barbossa And Sparrow
core: Barbossa yells in Jack Sparrow's face while Jack stares back unbothered; used for an angry rant met with a deadpan reply.
avoid: Not for friendly or agreeable conversations.

name: X But Y
core: Don Draper confidently pitches a blank board; used for absurd 'it's X, but Y' mashup pitches.
avoid: Not for sensible or serious ideas.

name: Confession Kid
core: A boy hides his face in shame; used to confess embarrassing habits or secrets.
avoid: Not for proud moments or other people's mistakes.

name: VAR Decision
core: A stadium screen shows a VAR decision; used to announce an official verdict on a petty dispute.
avoid: Not for situations with no ruling or judgement.

name: Yer A Wizard Harry
core: Hagrid tells Harry he's a wizard; used to announce someone has a surprising new status or skill.
avoid: Not for insults or bad news.

name: Interrupting Bird
core: A small bird keeps trying to speak and a big bird loudly cuts it off; used for being repeatedly interrupted or talked over.
avoid: Not for polite, turn-taking conversations.

name: Dr Evil One Million Dollars
core: Dr Evil, pinky to lip, demands one million dollars; used for demands that sound huge but are laughably outdated or small.
avoid: Not for reasonable or modest requests.

name: Josh Megan
core: Josh stands frozen in exhausted exasperation; used for weary disbelief when someone does the annoying thing again.
avoid: Not for happy or excited reactions.

name: Kids Afraid Of Rabbit
core: Two kids cower in a corner, terrified of a harmless bunny; used for overreacting in fear to something trivial.
avoid: Not for genuinely dangerous threats.

name: Double Yes Chad
core: Two Nordic Yes Chads face each other in calm agreement; used when two sides proudly agree on something controversial.
avoid: Not for disagreements or arguments.

name: Heroes III Message Box
core: A blank Heroes of Might and Magic III event dialog; used to narrate everyday events as a game message you can only click OK on.
avoid: Not for anything needing a picture of a person's reaction.

name: Sad Wojak Cycle
core: A sad Wojak sits inside an endless loop of arrows; used for a miserable cycle you keep repeating.
avoid: Not for one-off events or happy routines.

name: He Was A Boy She Was A Girl
core: Jesse and Jane stand apart in Breaking Bad, captioned with the Sk8er Boi opener; used to label two things obviously destined to clash or pair up.
avoid: Not for situations without two clearly matched sides.

name: Carefully He's A Hero
core: A crowd gently carries an exhausted Spider-Man, 'carefully, he's a hero'; used to honour someone for a small heroic act.
avoid: Not for mocking someone or for actual failures.

name: Busy
core: An office worker buried under a mountain of paperwork; used for being utterly swamped with work.
avoid: Not for relaxed or quiet days.

name: Darth Vader Where Is Padme
core: Vader anxiously asks where something precious is, right after he was the one who destroyed it.
slots: the anxious question about the lost thing
aliases: where is padme is she safe
avoid: Not for genuine concern; the joke is that you caused the loss.

name: Loud Music
core: Cranking the volume to max and screaming along when a favorite song or moment hits.
avoid: Not for calm or quiet enjoyment.

name: Stop Cop
core: A cop holds up a hand to stop someone from doing something they shouldn't.
avoid: Not for encouraging or approving something.

name: Adam Silver Get Ready To Learn Buddy
core: A smug explainer gestures as if about to teach someone a lesson they didn't ask for.
avoid: Not for sincere, welcome teaching.

name: You Wouldn't Download A
core: Parody of the anti-piracy ad, finishing 'you wouldn't download a...' with something absurd you obviously would.
avoid: Not for serious anti-piracy messaging.

name: Who Are We
core: A leader rallies a crowd with call-and-response questions until the last answer reveals they have no idea what they want or how.
avoid: Not for groups that actually agree on a plan.

name: Depends On The Context
core: Someone asks a simple question and the Doctor launches into an overcomplicated 'it depends on the context' answer.
avoid: Not for questions with a straight yes or no answer.

name: Grim Reaper Claw Machine
core: Death plays a claw machine, randomly plucking one victim out of a crowd who are all equally doomed.
avoid: Not for real deaths or tragedies.

name: Fake Search
core: A fake dark-mode search screen showing an embarrassingly revealing query someone typed.
avoid: Not for real screenshots of someone's private searches.

name: So It Begins
core: Theoden grimly acknowledges that an expected ordeal has finally started.
aliases: lord of the rings so it begins
avoid: Not for happy or exciting beginnings.

name: Subtle Pickup Liner
core: A smug finger-gunning guy delivers a cheesy, sneaky pickup line built on a pun.
avoid: Not for genuinely smooth or sincere flirting.

name: I Know But He Can
core: Thor admits he can't beat the enemy himself, so he unleashes something far more destructive that can.
avoid: Not for fair fights won on your own strength.

name: Guy Smoking While Two People Fight
core: Two people brawl over something while a third calmly ignores it all and does his own thing.
avoid: Not for situations where everyone is involved in the conflict.
